name: [💥RETRO] build a dog empire 🐕
desc:
👋 Welcome to Build a Dog Empire!
💟 A passion project about purchasing Dogs and letting them dig up items to sell!
📦 Changes and bug patches frequently

🐛THIS GAME IS IN EARLY BETA EXPECT BUGS AND CHANGES

Feel free to leave feedback or ideas in the given Roblox upvote (or downvote 🥺) feature or join our community server down below!

Bear with me, I'm trying my hardest to update game and be active in the community, but I am only one person. Have fun creating your Dog Empire!
